metadata.title: Database performance debugging enabled and Admin UI: close read trans…
metadata.author: crivetimihai

description:
This PR fixes admin UI endpoints holding read-only DB transactions open during template rendering, which led to idle-in-transaction timeouts and PendingRollbackError cascades under load.

## Changes

- Commit admin DB sessions before rendering templates/partials to release connections promptly.
- Update admin UI tests to call admin_ui with keyword args after the handler change.
- Clarify SQLALCHEMY_ECHO=true requires LOG_LEVEL=INFO|DEBUG in docs and compose comments.
- Enable pg_stat_statements in compose for DB profiling visibility.
- Set DB_METRICS_RECORDING_ENABLED=true in compose to capture DB metrics during perf runs.
- Document PgBouncer advisory lock behavior in transaction pooling.
- Add a preflight port‑8080 check to make monitoring-up.

Closes #1934

## Notes

- This mitigates admin UI idle-in-transaction timeouts but does not address admin query fan-out.

commits.message:
Database performance debugging enabled and Admin UI: close read transactions before rendering to avoid idle-in-transaction timeouts #1934

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
